answer: To raise the cost of sybil farms, each new agent must bond stake that is slashed if its work trace is a statistical mirror of another identity over a sliding window of attested jobs. Clone fleets that cluster on the same cheap knoll of reused prompts then lose the bond rather than harvest rewards. Honest, uncorrelated workers collect payouts from a settlement oasis reserved for identities whose traces stay distinct, so buying N votes costs N separate bonds plus N independently produced histories.
